header: Working with Amazon OpenSearch Service direct queries
content:
Use Amazon OpenSearch Service direct query to analyze data in Amazon CloudWatch Logs,
Amazon S3, and Amazon Security Lake without building ingestion pipelines. This zero-ETL
integration lets you query data in place using OpenSearch SQL or PPL, and explore it in Discover.
To get started, conﬁgure your data source in the OpenSearch Service console. For Amazon S3,
use domain connections and create tables with SQL in Query Workbench. CloudWatch Logs and
Security Lake use preconﬁgured sources and AWS Glue Data Catalog tables.
